problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis in the direction of increasing $x$ where $x\ge 0.$ When the displacement of $P$ from the origin is $x\,m,$ the velocity is $v\,m/s,$ and the acceleration is $(4-x)\,{m/s}^{2}.$ If $P$ has velocity $v=6\,m/s$ at the origin, find the maximum velocity of the particle.

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Properties of Objects Described as Functions of Displacement
